newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean holiday traffic claims 86 lives.
newsitem.headline: South Korean holiday traffic claims 86 lives.

text.p: Traffic accidents have killed 86 people and injured more than 3,200 as millions of South Koreans streamed out of the cities for hometown visits for the Chusok holiday, the Korean Thanksgiving, police said on Sunday.
National police figures showed, however, the death toll was down from 105 during last year's Chusok holiday.
The number of injuries and car accidents, which stood at 2,630, also dropped from last year, when about 4,540 people were injured and 2,950 accidents reported, the figures showed.
Emergency services, backed by police helicopters, remained on alert because many South Koreans have extended the three-day holiday, which began on Thursday, to Sunday.

More than half of South Korea's 45 million people travelled to their ancestral homes to venerate their forebears over the Chusok holiday, which is one of the most important celebrations in the country, in the time-honoured Confucian tradition.
